coverage: Regional report; numerical extraction remains incomplete.
report_note: The linked 2019 district/city image is hosted on Commons and attributed there to the census portal, with an unknown author. Its 2024 upload is not a new survey. Treat it as a visual aid and retain the source-provenance limitation.
regional_report: The census-based literature gives Russian as the usual home language for 71.4% of residents, versus about 26% Belarusian. This differs substantially from declared mother tongue. A 2023 demographic study examines reliability issues in the 2019 results; the district map does not resolve those issues.
